label.en: CMV retinitis or transplant prevention — induction 5 mg/kg every 12 h

text.fa: رتینیت ۱۴ تا ۲۱ روز؛ پیوند ۷ تا ۱۴ روز. انفوزیون ۱ ساعته، نه بولوس.
text.en: Retinitis 14–21 days; transplant 7–14 days. 1-hour infusion, never bolus.

label.en: Maintenance — 5 mg/kg once daily (7 days a week) or 6 mg/kg (5 days a week)

text.fa: هشدار جعبه‌ای: سمیت خونی (نوتروپنی، کم‌خونی، ترومبوسیتوپنی)، کاهش باروری، سمیت جنینی و سرطان‌زایی.
text.en: Boxed warning: haematological toxicity, impaired fertility, fetal toxicity, mutagenesis and carcinogenesis.

text.en: CrCl <70: reduce induction and maintenance doses per label Table 1.

text.en: Label: can cause fetal harm. Dangerous in pregnancy.

pregnancy.quote: Fetal Toxicity: Based on animal data, ganciclovir has the potential to cause birth defects in humans [see Warnings and Precautions (5.4) ].

text.fa: برچسب: شیردهی توصیه نمی‌شود یا باید بین دارو و شیردهی یکی انتخاب شود.
text.en: Label: breastfeeding not recommended, or choose between the drug and breastfeeding.

lactation.quote: Advise nursing mothers that breastfeeding is not recommended during treatment with ganciclovir because of the potential for serious adverse reactions in nursing infants [see Warnings and Precautions (5.1 , 5.3 , 5.4 , 5.5) , Nonclinical Toxicology (13.1) ].

text.fa: برچسب برای کودکان شرط، محدودیت سنی یا نکته دارد؛ جمله برچسب در زیر آمده است.
text.en: The label has conditions, age limits or notes for children; the label sentence is quoted below.

pediatric.quote: Safety and efficacy of ganciclovir have not been established in pediatric patients.

text.fa: برچسب: در سالمندان با احتیاط و معمولاً از دوز پایین شروع شود.
text.en: Label: use with caution in older adults, usually starting at the low end of the dose range.

geriatric.quote: In general, dose selection for an elderly patient should be cautious, reflecting the greater frequency of decreased hepatic, renal, or cardiac function, and of concomitant disease or other drug therapy.

text.en: Label has advice on pregnancy testing, contraception or fertility for females and males.
